title: Smart RCM Billing — Modern Healthcare Positioning & Booking Funnel
brief: A sister healthcare brand required distinct market positioning centered around modern clinical credibility, denial rate reduction, and an immediate meeting-booking workflow rather than an extensive multi-field form.
approach: Developed a lighter, teal-accented layout with prominent clinical imagery and value-led messaging ("We handle your medical billing so you can cut denials"). Implemented sticky contact bars and direct calendar booking triggers to eliminate conversion friction.
outcome: Delivered clear brand differentiation without cannibalising sister company messaging, producing a high-converting meeting booking funnel for medical practices.
